title: AN AGENT EVAL -- one minimal real run that measures the kit, judged by deterministic oracles
description: A fixture host started from capabilities this host has taken (`takes`, by id), a one-sentence `task` that tempts a law violation, and a route cell that caps the run (the cheapest sufficient model and effort, a spend cap where the product has one, a wall-time stop). Accepted by ORACLES only -- the dispatch port's admission (the gates named in `expects.refused_by` refuse what they must), the fixture's own `check`, its tree untouched -- never by the worker's own account. Re-run only when a file matching `inputs` changes (ADR-024).

adapter.description: The dispatch adapter the task is routed to.

takes.description: The ids of capabilities THIS host has taken that the fixture is started with.

route.description: The fixture's one route cell (`route-table` fields): decision_density, reversibility, and the caps.

inputs.description: Globs over this host: when a matching file changes, the eval is due again.
